[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: KAN-54 Discord reply-context parity: reconcile PR #655 with live hot-patch, deploy, and split out voice-out defect
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/655
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/656
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1942
  
  Details:
  Brought the Discord adapter's native-reply handling to Telegram parity and got it deployed and verified — including discovering and resolving a two-implementations problem that #655 alone would have shipped as a regression.
  
  WHAT HAPPENED
  PR #655 ported reply-context to Discord, but while preparing the record I found a SECOND, independent implementation already live and uncommitted on /opt/truesight_autopilot: HEAD still pre-merge 5f84ecf, app/discord_adapter.py modified 07:19:01 UTC, gateway started 07:21:49. That explained why the governor's message prefix carried seconds while #655 emitted minutes only. Neither implementation was correct alone.
  
  THREE DEFECTS IN #655, FIXED IN #656
  1. Deleted origin silently dropped. Discord sends referenced_message: null + message_reference when the origin was deleted; #655's guard returned "" — resurrecting the exact bug being fixed. Now emits an explicit "no longer available" clause.
  2. Voice replies lost reply context. #655 did prompt = transcript, discarding the prefix it had just built. Now composes reply_ctx + transcript. Regression-locked by test.
  3. Seconds precision restored (%H:%M:%S UTC), so two messages in the same minute stay distinguishable.
  
  Kept #655's richer _describe_discord_media (content_type + sticker_items) and its committed tests — the live hot-patch had none.
  
  TESTING
  49/49 in tests/test_discord_adapter.py; full suite 2532 passed / 1 failed, the failure being an unrelated load-sensitive Redis session-lock flake (12/12 green in isolation). Also caught and fixed a test of my own that asserted a Python-version-specific fromisoformat behaviour (passed locally on 3.10, failed in CI on 3.11+) — I had encoded my host's interpreter version rather than the contract.
  
  DEPLOY VERIFIED FUNCTIONALLY, NOT BY TIMESTAMP
  HEAD == origin/main == cb448f6, 0 behind; no dirty diff on adapter/tests. Against the imported running module: seconds precision confirmed, deleted-origin confirmed, non-reply returns "", media naming confirmed. No err-level journalctl entries post-restart; gateway READY and dispatching normally.
  
  SCOPE SPLIT
  KAN-54 closed Done for the reply-context work. KAN-91 filed separately for the voice-out defect (edge-tts synthesis 403 on a stale Sec-MS-GEC-Version token, so send_voice is never reached) — assigned to me, In Progress — so that gap is not buried by KAN-54's closure.
  
  Follow-ups filed in agentic_ai_context OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md: reply-to-a-reply is one level deep, and deploy-tree drift is a systemic risk (uncommitted hot-patches are invisible to git and destroyed by a naive deploy).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
